subject: general
question: In a certain code language, RAMESH is written as AREMHS and PRAKIL is written as 'RPKALI'. How will RISHIPAL be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

RAMESH is written as AREMHS

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c35d7e884577667e43d3ff7b52daaed48ccb866dc0c2032910f51683cbfd2436.png] 

And,

PRAKIL is written as RPKALI

 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0d94bcccbac73e42d77cd2f5ab8da50ea11fd125c2da84237d6c7922365d047.png] 

Similarly,

RISHIPAL is written as IRHSPILA

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad9b46fc355b12ad2881e071541b0cda4b92e44a459fc876bc6805b8775ebdfc.png] 

Hence, 'IRHSPILA' is the correct answer.
